0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000010_ALPHINAUD
0.description: The question is, how will the Empire respond to the disappearance of Omega and the primal...

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: Oh, I didn't see you there. Forgive me. Word from Baelsar's Wall is proving long in the coming, and my mind cannot help but stray to grim places.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000030_TATARU
2.description: Alphinaud! A message from the Alliance!

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000040_ALPHINAUD
3.description: It's about time! Pray summon the others at once.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000060_ALPHINAUD
5.description: ...General Aldynn reports that his forces have secured the breach in Baelsar's Wall.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000070_YSHTOLA
6.description: And what of the primal and Omega?

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000080_ALPHINAUD
7.description: There is still no sign of either at this time. He writes that they will begin a more thorough investigation shortly...

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000090_ALPHINAUD
8.description: And, as expected, he wishes to petition the aid of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000110_ALPHINAUD
10.description: The Alliance's decision to capture a part of Baelsar's Wall is...open to interpretation.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000120_ALISAIE
11.description: The Wall serves to demarcate imperial territory, Ala Mhigo included, from the rest of Eorzea.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000130_ALISAIE
12.description: To an observer, the Alliance's actions could be seen as a prelude to invasion.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000140_ALPHINAUD
13.description: Indeed. And the Alliance leaders have no wish to be branded invaders.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000150_LYSE
14.description: (-Lyse-)You're saying they won't fight for Ala Mhigo? Even after everything that's happened?

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000160_ALPHINAUD
15.description: Not without the consent of her people, no. Make no mistake, Lyse─the Alliance is in complete agreement that the Empire must be purged from Eorzea.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000170_ALPHINAUD
16.description: However, they will not set foot in Gyr Abania until they have formally secured the consent and cooperation of the Ala Mhigan opposition.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000180_YSHTOLA
17.description: ...They would have us act as intermediaries?

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000190_ALPHINAUD
18.description: Precisely. The Scions are uniquely qualified to serve in this capacity─that is to say, Lyse is, given her personal connection to the Resistance.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000200_ALPHINAUD
19.description: Who better than you to broker an agreement between the Alliance and the people of Ala Mhigo? ...Assuming you are willing, of course?

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000210_LYSE
20.description: (-Lyse-)Of course I am. You know I'd like nothing more!

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000220_ALPHINAUD
21.description: As for who should accompany you on said diplomatic mission...I had a mind to volunteer myself.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000230_LYSE
22.description: (-Lyse-)Well, that covers the talking part. But you just know there'll be trouble along the way. Are you available?

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
24.description: As if you have to ask!

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000240_LYSE
26.description: (-Lyse-)Thanks. It means a lot, knowing you'll be there.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000250_LYSE
27.description: (-Lyse-)Look, I know I've kept things from you, and I'm sorry, I really am. But that's all over now, I swear. And...it'd mean a lot to me, having you at my side.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000260_YSHTOLA
28.description: I too shall accompany you. Such endeavors are seldom hampered by a surfeit of healers.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000270_KRILE
29.description: Good point! Allow me to offer my services as well.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000280_ALISAIE
30.description: I have spent quite enough time here of late, so I'll be coming, but we will need someone to keep an eye on things.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000290_ALISAIE
31.description: I trust you have no objections?

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000300_URIANGER
32.description: None, my lady. Gladly shall I continue to serve as caretaker of the Waking Sands, and there keep watch for signs of primal and Ascian activity both.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000310_THANCRED
33.description: As capable as my learned friend undoubtedly is, there are some troubles that may prove too much for a single Scion─on account of which, I mean to stay.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000320_ALPHINAUD
34.description: It is settled, then. Let us each see to our preparations.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000340_ALPHINAUD
36.description: Well, then. Tataru─I leave the Rising Stones in your capable hands.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000350_TATARU
37.description: Don't worry, Alphinaud! I'll see that the place is still standing when you come back!

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000360_YUGIRI
38.description: Mistress Y'shtola has unfolded all. You are bound for Gyr Abania?

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000370_ALPHINAUD
39.description: Aye. The Alliance would have us make contact with the Ala Mhigan Resistance as soon as possible.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000380_YUGIRI
40.description: It begins, then─as soon it shall in Doma, if the gods are good. 'Tis but a pity that it must be now. I am sorry that we shall not be present to fight beside you in the battles to come...

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000390_ALPHINAUD
41.description: You have stood with us countless times, Lady Yugiri. Pray do not apologize.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000400_YUGIRI
42.description: Then let us thank you instead. You and yours stood with us from the first, when we came to this land as refugees in search of sanctuary.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000410_YUGIRI
43.description: Loath am I to think what might have become of my people had you not extended to us the hand of friendship. We will never forget─this I solemnly swear.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000420_ALPHINAUD
44.description: Much has changed since first you set foot on these shores. Revenant's Toll stands as a testament to that. I am sure your people will manage in your absence.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000430_YUGIRI
45.description: Indeed. They have built a new home for themselves, and no longer need me to shepherd them. The time has come for Gosetsu and I to return to our master─to our home.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000440_LYSE
46.description: (-Lyse-)I know how you feel. It's time I went home too...

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000450_GOSETSU
47.description: Though our battlefields be a thousand malms apart, our purpose is one! Let all men hearken to the clarion call of freedom─of liberation─from Eorzea to the Far East, that they may rise up and cast down the curs of Garlemald!

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000460_LYSE
48.description: (-Lyse-)Take care, you hear me? When all of this is over, we're going to celebrate─together─just you wait!

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000470_YUGIRI
49.description: I should like that very much. Fare you well.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000480_LYSENARRATION
50.description: I remember crossing the border. Standing in Gyr Abania once more.<hex:02100103>Me and my fellow Scions...the Warrior of Light among us.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000490_LYSENARRATION
51.description: Behind us, Baelsar's Wall, cutting the land in two.<hex:02100103>Freedom on one side, tyranny on the other.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000500_LYSENARRATION
52.description: Tyranny...and the promise of a new beginning.<hex:02100103>But one that could only be bought with flames and blood.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000510_LYSENARRATION
53.description: I remember the old stories.<hex:02100103>How the breaker of worlds came down from on high and cleft the earth with a single blow.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000520_LYSENARRATION
54.description: Rhalgr's Reach. A holy place, and a fitting home for the Resistance.<hex:02100103>For the brave and the true, the loyal sons and daughters of Ala Mhigo.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000530_LYSENARRATION
55.description: They were waiting for us there. Men and women whose souls still cried out for what was lost.<hex:02100103>For what could be ours again.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000540_CONRAD
56.description: Allow me to welcome you once more to Rhalgr's Reach, our humble headquarters.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000550_CONRAD
57.description: My name is Conrad Kemp, and I have the dubious honor of overseeing operations here.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000560_ALPHINAUD
58.description: It is a pleasure to meet you, Master Kemp. I am Alphinaud Leveilleur, of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, as are my comrades.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000570_ALPHINAUD
59.description: Before I speak of our purpose here, pray allow me to thank you for sheltering Yda─forgive me─Lyse and Papalymo at great risk to yourselves.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000580_CONRAD
60.description: Now, now, there's no need for that. They risked their necks for us enough times. 'Twas the least we could do.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000590_LYSE
61.description: I-I wanted to... I mean, about the mask and...

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000600_CONRAD
62.description: Ahhh, don't fret over that. You're not the first person to take up arms against the Empire under a false name. We'd do the same if we had any sense.<hex:02100103>...My condolences for your loss, child.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000610_LYSE
63.description: ...Papalymo laid down his life to save us─to give us a chance to make a better future for ourselves.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000620_LYSE
64.description: There will never be a better time to drive the Garleans from our lands. But we have to take the lead on this─we can't leave it to fanatics like Ilberd.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000630_CONRAD
65.description: More than a few of our people were taken in by his promises. Followed him all the way to the Wall. Good men and women who never came back.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000640_CONRAD
66.description: When M'naago told us what had happened─how the bastard had made sacrifices of them for his twisted ritual─by Rhalgr, it filled me with an unholy fury... But what's done is done. Best we can do now is see that it wasn't all in vain.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000650_ALPHINAUD
67.description: That is why we are here today, sir─to see that some good comes of this tragedy.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000660_ALPHINAUD
68.description: On behalf of the Eorzean Alliance, we do hereby extend a formal offer of military assistance to the Ala Mhigan Resistance.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000670_CONRAD
69.description: Do you, now? Well, go on then. I'm sure there's more to it than that.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000680_CONRAD
70.description: ...So that's the way of it, eh? The Alliance, hoping to avoid a direct confrontation with the superior forces of the Empire, wishes to engage them by proxy with our vastly inferior ones?

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000690_CONRAD
71.description: My comrades and I must confer on your proposal. A moment, if you please...

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000700_ALPHINAUD
72.description: Of course, Master Kemp. Take all the time you require.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000710_CONRAD
73.description: Thank you all for waiting. We have reached a consensus.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000720_CONRAD
74.description: I, Conrad Kemp, do hereby accept the Eorzean Alliance's proposal. You must understand, however, that our cooperation comes with certain caveats.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000740_CONRAD
76.description: I take no joy in this, just so you know. Were it within my power, I'd offer you more assistance.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000750_CONRAD
77.description: But the Resistance is far more fragmented than you realize. The men and women in my care belong to but one of many factions.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000760_CONRAD
78.description: Simply put, I can only speak for the people of Rhalgr's Reach.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000770_CONRAD
79.description: Now, I have every intention of appealing to the others, and I expect many will agree─but it will take time, and I cannot guarantee universal support.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000780_ALPHINAUD
80.description: Understood. I shall see that the Alliance is under no misapprehensions as to your position.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000790_CONRAD
81.description: Much obliged...but that's not the whole of it. As you can imagine, the loss of those who cast their lot with the Griffin left us short on numbers.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000800_CONRAD
82.description: Some of our most trusted veterans died at the Wall, and we've had to fill their posts with the young and inexperienced. Frankly, everything's in a right bloody mess.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000810_LYSE
83.description: Oh, we'd be more than happy to help you get back on your feet. If we're going to work together, we'll be doing ourselves a favor!

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000820_CONRAD
84.description: Well, there's no shortage of work to be done, that's for sure. We're in dire need of new blood too.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000830_KRILE
85.description: Y'shtola and I could lend a hand in the infirmary. From what I saw, they could do with a few more healers.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000840_ALPHINAUD
86.description: Very well. I, for my part, shall return to the Rising Stones. I am certain there are others among the Scions who would welcome the opportunity to fight for Ala Mhigan liberation.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000850_LYSE
87.description: Um... Is there anything else we can do to help?

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000860_CONRAD
88.description: I had something else in mind for you lot. M'naago and Meffrid will tell you more.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000870_LYSE
89.description: Understood. We won't let you down.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000880_RAUBAHN
90.description: It is good to see you again, my friends. I hope you are here to tell me you have made contact with the Resistance?

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000900_ALISAIE
92.description: Allow me to introduce M'naago, of Rhalgr's Reach.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000910_MNAAGO
93.description: At your service, sir! And may I say what an absolute honor it is to stand before the Bull of Ala Mhigo!

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000920_RAUBAHN
94.description: These are not the bloodsands, girl. You and I are but soldiers on a battlefield fighting for the same cause.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000940_MNAAGO
96.description: Ahem. On behalf of Commander Kemp of the Ala Mhigan Resistance, I present to you our formal response.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000950_RAUBAHN
97.description: ...Good. I am glad we have reached an accord. Though I was not aware you had suffered such losses.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000960_MNAAGO
98.description: Aye... Some of our finest took part in the Griffin's doomed assault, and we've been struggling to find new recruits ever since.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000970_MNAAGO
99.description: The massacre has cast a pall over the whole Resistance, and many who might once have been open to joining us have since thought better of it.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000980_ALISAIE
100.description: After all of the Griffin's false promises, one can hardly blame them. They have no desire to give their lives for a lost cause.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_000990_RAUBAHN
101.description: We will not lie to them. This is war, and lives will be lost. Yet what we offer is not the fever dream of a madman, but true hope.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001000_PIPIN
102.description: The people need proof of this, Father. Let us show it to them.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001010_PIPIN
103.description: I say we stand shoulder to shoulder with our new allies and engage the Garleans in open warfare. The Resistance must demonstrate that they can hold their own against imperial regulars, and with our assistance, I am confident they can do just that.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001020_PIPIN
104.description: If we can achieve even a token victory, I believe it will serve to rekindle the hope of the Ala Mhigan people, and inspire them to rise up once more.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001030_MNAAGO
105.description: Aye, aye... Once word spread that we'd won a battle against the Garleans, I wager we'd have new recruits flocking to us from malms around. The question is, when and where do we strike?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001040_PIPIN
106.description: I'm glad you asked. I have a plan...

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001050_GRYNEWAHT
107.description: Things looked grim for us after Carteneau, didn't they? Oh, how they doubted us... Yet here we are, right as rain, with fancy new toys to put through their paces...

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001060_GRYNEWAHT
108.description: Bwahahahaha! It's like all my namedays have come at once!

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001070_GRYNEWAHT
109.description: Well, well, well! If it isn't Garlond's little troublemaker! Heh heh heh! I can't wait to see the look on Zenos's face when I bring him your head!

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001080_GRYNEWAHT
110.description: That is, if my secret weapons here don't grind it into mush! ATTAAACK!

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001090_GRYNEWAHT
111.description: Gaaah! Damn it all! Miracles of magitek design, my arse! I've passed harder stools than these piles of scrap!

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001100_GRYNEWAHT
112.description: You'll pay for this! Mark my words, the next time we meet will be the last!

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001110_RAUBAHN
113.description: Aye! Run and tell your viceroy! The day belongs to Ala Mhigo!

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001190_LYSENARRATION
121.description: I remember the peaks of Gyr Abania. Silent watchmen that would stand long after we were gone.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001200_LYSENARRATION
122.description: We came seeking allies to join us in the fight against the Empire. People who had had enough.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001210_LYSENARRATION
123.description: People who had suffered every possible indignity.<hex:02100103>Who had been treated like animals, day after day after day...

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001230_MEFFRID
125.description: Worse. Skulls. Listen, Lyse─whatever happens, stay hidden and do not intervene. Understood?

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001250_SKULLSOLDIERA
127.description: You there─halt! You know you shouldn't be here... Explain yourself.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001260_G3F2VILLAGER
128.description: Forgive me, sir! I-I came to deliver the tributum!

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001270_SKULLSOLDIERA
129.description: ...Oh aye? A likely story! Only a fool would dare to come so late.<hex:02100103>Or mayhap...a Resistance spy.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001280_G3F2VILLAGER
130.description: No! No, you've got it all wrong! I was waylaid by bandits! It's not my fault!

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001310_SKULLSOLDIERB
133.description: ...Is this a joke? You don't seriously expect us to believe this is a fifth?<hex:02100103>How stupid do you think we are?

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001320_G3F2VILLAGER
134.description: It is, I swear! On me mother's life...

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001330_SKULLSOLDIERA
135.description: Spare us. You came late, you lied about bandits, and then you tried to cheat the Empire of its due.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001340_MEFFRID
136.description: Think you can kill them all─including the ones watching from the tower? Even if you did, others would come for him─and his family. You'd be condemning them all to a life of hard labor─assuming they didn't just execute them, that is.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001360_SKULLSOLDIERA
138.description: It's your bloody fault we're stuck out here patrolling this godsforsaken wasteland! It's your fault I have to listen to people go on and on about how “Ala Mhigans can't be trusted”!

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001370_SKULLSOLDIERA
139.description: I've worked and toiled harder than any man! I'm a citizen, godsdammit! And what are you!? A stupid, stubborn little dog who'd sooner bite the hand that feeds him and pine for the good old days!

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001380_FORDOLA
140.description: That's enough! Lord Zenos is expecting our report.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001390_MEFFRID
141.description: I'll bet the poor bastard can't believe his luck. He gets to go home.<hex:02100103>We should do the same.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001400_GARLEANLEADERA
142.description: (-Imperial Tribunus Militum-)Alliance forces have occupied Castrum Oriens and taken up positions along the length of the Wall. Our patrols have engaged their reconnaissance parties on sight, but there have been no significant exchanges...

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001410_GARLEANLEADERA
143.description: (-Imperial Tribunus Militum-)...Save one. A unit tasked with field-testing prototype magitek weapons was attacked. The weapons were destroyed, with the unit sustaining near-total casualties.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001430_GARLEANLEADERB
145.description: (-Imperial Pilus Prior-)My lord, there was but a single survivor from the unit in question, which falls under my command.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001440_GARLEANLEADERB
146.description: (-Imperial Pilus Prior-)According to his report, they were ambushed by a contingent of Eorzean Alliance regulars, abetted by Resistance insurgents.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001450_ZENOS
147.description: Hm. A simple ambush, and only one survivor. A fine day's work.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001460_ZENOS
148.description: The stubbornness to survive is not without worth... He may live. However, the XIIth is no place for the weak.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001470_GARLEANLEADERB
149.description: (-Imperial Pilus Prior-)He shall be relegated at once, my lord. As you say, the XIIth is no place for cowards who count their lives more precious than the cause.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001480_ZENOS
150.description: Indeed, indeed. We have no need of cowards...

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001510_ZENOS
153.description: Cowards who defer critical missions to their subordinates─who hide within their castra, never meeting their prey in battle, never staring into the whites of their eyes.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001520_ZENOS
154.description: Why, when confronted with a heretofore unknown eikon, did we surrender the Wall to the Alliance?

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001530_ZENOS
155.description: Because my honored father, in his infinite wisdom, has not seen fit to grant us leave to march on their lands.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001540_ZENOS
156.description: Accordingly, we have extended an invitation to our neighbors.<hex:02100103>Gyr Abania is where we shall host them─the field upon which we shall enjoy the sport of kings.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001550_ZENOS
157.description: Patience is paramount. Cornered animals may have spirit, but they are ultimately predictable, and very poor sport. But if one dangles the promise of freedom before them, while nipping at their heels to stoke their passion, then things become interesting.<hex:02100103>It is a delicate dance...and one which asks much of my hounds.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001560_ZENOS
158.description: And so I put the question to you, my fellow huntsmen: how shall we deal with these savages?

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001570_FORDOLA
159.description: My lord, I have a proposal!

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001580_GARLEANLEADERA
160.description: (-Imperial Tribunus Militum-)Silence, Ala Mhigan! You do forget yourself!

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001590_GARLEANLEADERA
161.description: (-Imperial Tribunus Militum-)Only by the grace of Lord van Baelsar were you afforded a place here─and that in name alone! We have no need of your “proposals,” savage.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001610_ZENOS
163.description: This “savage” yearns to hunt her own... The floor is yours, Commander.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001630_PIPIN
165.description: Excellent... The disposition of the imperial forces is exactly as expected.<hex:02100103>I will notify Father.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001640_PIPIN
166.description: Cannon fire! Where did it come from?

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001650_ALISAIE
167.description: Smoke! There! Is that─ Oh gods, it's Rhalgr's Reach!

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001660_ALPHINAUD
168.description: It's no use─I think someone's jamming our communications.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001670_ALISAIE
169.description: You don't think... Could this be part of a coordinated attack?

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001680_PIPIN
170.description: Too early to draw conclusions.<hex:02100103>We must abort the assault and return to the Reach at once.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001690_FORDOLA
171.description: Forward! FORWARD! Give them no quarter!

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001780_ZENOS
180.description: Stand aside, Pilus. This one has promise.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001790_FORDOLA
181.description: Have a care, my lord. She's not like the others.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001800_ZENOS
182.description: Hm. Do not disappoint me, girl. Or I will kill you.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001810_CONRAD
183.description: Seven hells... It's him! It's Zenos!

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001820_LYSE
184.description: The viceroy? Oh...you are a dead man!

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001900_CONRAD
192.description: Hold the line, by Rhalgr! Hold the line!

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001930_ALPHINAUD
195.description: We saw the smoke and thought we heard explosions. Are we under attack?

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001940_KRILE
196.description: The imperials were all over us before we realized what was happening.<hex:02100103>No one knew where to run or what to do─it was chaos.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001950_KRILE
197.description: Lyse and Master Kemp rallied the guards and bought us enough time to get some of the wounded to safety, but I haven't seen either of them since...

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001960_PIPIN
198.description: Confound it! If we lose the Reach, this will all have been for naught!

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001970_ALPHINAUD
199.description: Arenvald─can you escort these people to the Wall?

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_001990_ALPHINAUD
201.description: Our place is at the Reach. We must offer such aid and succor as we are able. Saving lives is now our paramount concern.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002000_PIPIN
202.description: If we can hold back the imperials until Father sends reinforcements, we may yet turn the tide...

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002010_KRILE
203.description: I'll join you. I've done all I can for these people, and you'll be crying out for a healer in there.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002020_ALPHINAUD
204.description: I fear you're right. Come, there is no time to lose!

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002070_FORDOLA
209.description: Uh─ As you command, my lord.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002080_ZENOS
210.description: Your friends were a disappointment. But you...<hex:02100103>You will entertain me, will you not?

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002120_RAUBAHN
214.description: Nay. There has been enough death this day. See to the wounded.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
218.description: I think my pride might have taken a knock.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
219.description: Well enough. Next time, he will pay.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002150_RAUBAHN
221.description: 'Tis no ordinary foe could best the likes of you.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002160_RAUBAHN
222.description: Aye. I do not doubt it.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002170_RAUBAHN
223.description: To best the likes of you... Zenos is not what I took him to be.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002180_LYSE
224.description: Don't you die on me, Y'shtola! Hold on!

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002190_KRILE
225.description: Don't worry! It's going to be all right!

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002200_KRILE
226.description: Alphinaud! Master Kemp is all yours!

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002220_KRILE
228.description: Don't just stand there gawping! You're a healer, aren't you?

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002230_KRILE
229.description: Don't just stand there gawping! Hold her down while I work!

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002240_KRILE
230.description: The worst is passed, but without the proper facilities I can do no more.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002250_ALPHINAUD
231.description: Master Kemp too would be better served in the infirmary.<hex:02100103>Let us take them there without delay.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002260_KRILE
232.description: Give us a hand, would you, Lyse?

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002280_KRILE
234.description: I know you must be exhausted, but there will be others who need our help. Leave these two to us and look to the other wounded.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002290_CONRAD
235.description: Were it not for the swift actions of the Scions and the Alliance, many more would have died. You risked your lives to save ours, and for that we thank you.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002300_ALPHINAUD
236.description: There is no need for thanks. We are allies, are we not?

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002310_RAUBAHN
237.description: Aye, just so. Let us not dwell on this tragedy, but look to the future.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002320_CONRAD
238.description: The future...? I'm sorry, General, but there is no future for us.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002330_CONRAD
239.description: We've lost too many... Gods, I can still see Meffrid with that woman standing over him... <sigh> They've ripped the heart out of us, General. They've broken us. Our fight is over.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002350_CONRAD
241.description: I'll always hate them with every fiber of my being. For what they took from us, then and now. Our homeland...our freedom...our bloody children...

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002360_LYSE
242.description: You mean the Skulls... The youths who fight for Zenos.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002370_CONRAD
243.description: Crania Lupi. The Black Wolf's legacy, and our shame. A unit made up of children born to Ala Mhigan dignitaries who came of age during the occupation.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002380_CONRAD
244.description: Sons and daughters of Gyr Abania raised to be proud citizens of the Empire, with all the rights and responsibilities that entails.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002390_CONRAD
245.description: It'd be easy to curse them and call them traitors, but they're our children.<hex:02100103>Our flesh and blood! If the only way to forge the future we want is to cut down our own, then...

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002400_MNAAGO
246.description: Then what was it all for!?

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002420_MNAAGO
248.description: What will you say to the families of the fallen─to the mothers and the widows and the orphans? Will you tell them it was all for nothing!?

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002430_RAUBAHN
249.description: Listen to the girl. We dare not suffer our comrades' sacrifices to have been<hex:02100103>in vain. Now is the time to steel our resolve and press on, painful though<hex:02100103>it may be.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002440_CONRAD
250.description: And when Zenos comes back with his army? What then? This isn't the first time, you know. You'll be hard-pressed to find men brave or stupid enough to face him again.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002450_LYSE
251.description: I still can't believe how strong he was. He humiliated us back there,<hex:02100103>the Warrior of Light included. Gods help us if he's next in line to<hex:02100103>the Garlean throne.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002460_ALPHINAUD
252.description: Loath though I am to say it, we should not be surprised. Before succeeding van Baelsar in Ala Mhigo, Zenos led the imperial army to Doma, where he crushed the rebellion utterly.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002470_ALPHINAUD
253.description: As a matter of fact, Doma remains in his charge to this day. Suffice it to say, Varis's heir is a peerless warrior and an accomplished general. The question is, how are we to contend with such a foe?

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
255.description: We fight and we fight, and we keep on fighting until we win.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
256.description: We take the fight to Doma.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
257.description: I have a feeling you're about to tell us.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002480_ALPHINAUD
258.description: Come now, even you have your limits─but then...so too must he... One legatus ruling two provinces a world apart... Yes─divide and conquer. We kindle the flames of revolution in Doma once more, thereby forcing Zenos to fight a war on two fronts.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002490_ALPHINAUD
259.description: Interesting... You are suggesting we kindle the flames of revolution in Doma once more, and force Zenos to fight a war on two fronts?

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002500_ALPHINAUD
260.description: Well...to put it simply, we have one legatus overseeing two provinces a world apart. I say we divide and conquer─we kindle the flames of revolution in Doma once more, thereby forcing Zenos to fight a war on two fronts.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002510_CONRAD
261.description: For that, there would need to be someone left to fight on this front by the time you got back. Look, I'll not deny the plan has promise─and I feel for our brothers and sisters in Doma, truly I do─but I fear we lack the strength to<hex:02100103>see it through.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002520_RAUBAHN
262.description: Have faith in your people, Master Kemp. Them and the Scions. Hold fast, rebuild, and when all is in place, we shall defeat Zenos together.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002530_LYSE
263.description: If you're going to Doma, I'm coming too. I want to help our friends there...and make sure nothing like this ever happens again.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002540_RAUBAHN
264.description: Give us the time we need, and we will give you something far greater.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002550_CONRAD
265.description: Very well. For all you have done for us, we will fight on. But be swift, comrades. Ala Mhigo has suffered enough.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002560_URIANGER
266.description: Twelve be praised! Full sure was I that I had come too late.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002570_ALISAIE
267.description: Urianger? Tell me you haven't come all this way just to see us off.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002580_URIANGER
268.description: Nay, my lady. Ere you quit these shores for eastern climes, I wished to share some words of seeming import.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002590_URIANGER
269.description: "Look ye where the sun doth rise, see crimson embers, dark'ning skies...<hex:02100103>Look ye where the sun doth fall, see azure lost amidst the squall.“

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002600_ALISAIE
270.description: Well that sounds suitably foreboding. Another one of your prophecies, I presume?

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002610_URIANGER
271.description: Of Far Eastern origin, aye. It is mine earnest hope that this ancient wisdom may serve to guide you on your journey, for what dangers lie in wait for you upon those distant shores are yet beyond my knowing.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002620_ALISAIE
272.description: <sigh> A parting gift befitting your roundabout ways. Thank you.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002630_URIANGER
273.description: I have more than words for you, my lady.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002640_ALISAIE
274.description: It's beautiful... Is it for me?

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002650_URIANGER
275.description: Though undeniably powerful, your aetherial blade taxeth you greatly in the wielding. Not so this rapier, which shall serve you just as well 'gainst all but the most formidable foe.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002660_ALISAIE
276.description: Impressive... It feels as though it's attuned to my aether. I shall treasure it.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002670_CARVALLAIN
277.description: Honored guests! Say your farewells, for the moment of our parting draws nigh! A fair wind blows, and I mean to follow it!

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002680_ALISAIE
278.description: It would seem our ship is set to sail. Pray give my regards to Thancred and the others. And...take care.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002690_CARVALLAIN
279.description: A fine day, is it not? Fair winds and following seas.<hex:02100103>The <hex:021A020203>Misery<hex:021A020103> is enjoying herself.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002700_CARVALLAIN
280.description: Nevertheless, it would not do for you to spend the entirety of our voyage above deck. Let me show you to your quarters.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002710_TATARU
281.description: Uhh...i-is it supposed to do that?

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002730_KRAKENSDECKHAND
283.description: Captain! You're needed on deck. Somethin' queer's afoot. The winds died down, the waters went still, and all of a sudden we were dragged off course...

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002750_KRAKENSDECKHAND
285.description: Can't rightly say, sir, but some of the lads are mutterin' about seein' things in the water. Things as shouldn't be there...

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002760_CARVALLAIN
286.description: Oh, for the love of─ If you will excuse me a moment.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002770_CARVALLAIN
287.description: ...Actually, might I persuade you to join me? Loath though I am to admit it,<hex:02100103>I have a bad feeling about this.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002780_ALPHINAUD
288.description: That appears to be the last of them.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002790_CARVALLAIN
289.description: Word from the <hex:021A020203>Misery<hex:021A020103>. Repairs are complete, and we may resume our journey without further delay.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002800_ALPHINAUD
290.description: I swear, if I never hear another ghost story, it will be too soon...

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002810_LYSENARRATION
291.description: I remember the sea. The smell of the salt and the crash of the waves as we drew closer to Kugane...

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002820_LYSENARRATION
292.description: The only port open to outsiders in Hingashi, across the Ruby Sea from Othard. From Doma.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04000_002830_LYSENARRATION
293.description: All the colors of the rainbow, all the peoples of the world, all in one place.<hex:02100103>I wish you could have seen it...
